publications.title: OS-native Agents: Managing User Tasks in the Dynamic Mobile World

summary.zh: 将 Agent 接入操作系统原生的状态、能力与信任机制，在动态移动环境中持续协调跨应用任务；并构建可重放的 Android 基准 DynamicWorld。
summary.en: Integrating agents with native OS state, capability, and trust mechanisms to coordinate ongoing tasks in a changing mobile world, with the replayable Android benchmark DynamicWorld.

image_alt.zh: OS-native Agent 框架：持久化任务会话、原生状态监听、跨应用能力与授权机制。
image_alt.en: OS-native Agent framework with persistent task sessions, native state monitors, cross-application capabilities, and authorization.

publications.title: TierMem: Balancing Compressed Memory and Raw Evidence for Long-Horizon Agent Memory

summary.en: A two-tier agent memory framework that uses compact summaries by default and recovers raw evidence when more detail is needed. Provenance links and verified write-back help balance answer quality, context cost, and latency over long interactions.
summary.zh: 让 Agent 默认使用精简摘要，在证据不足时按需回溯原始日志。通过来源关联与验证后的记忆回写，在长期交互中兼顾回答质量、上下文开销和延迟。

image_alt.en: TierMem architecture linking summary memory to raw evidence with a router and consolidation loop.
image_alt.zh: TierMem 架构：通过路由器与证据回写连接摘要记忆和原始日志。

publications.title: MTalk-Bench: Evaluating Speech-to-Speech Models in Multi-Turn Dialogues via Arena-style and Rubrics Protocols

summary.en: A multi-turn speech-to-speech benchmark covering semantic content, paralinguistic cues, and ambient sounds. It combines Arena-style comparisons with hierarchical rubrics to diagnose model capabilities and assess the reliability of human and LLM judges.
summary.zh: 面向多轮语音对话的评测基准，覆盖语义信息、副语言线索与环境声音。结合 Arena 成对比较与分层 Rubrics，分析模型能力以及人工与 LLM 裁判的评测可靠性。

image_alt.en: MTalk-Bench overview connecting speech-aware data construction with Arena-style and rubric-based evaluation.
image_alt.zh: MTalk-Bench 总览：从多维语音对话构造到 Arena 成对比较与 Rubrics 细粒度评测。
